summary: The SQLite VFS identity gate now directly consumes the verified handle and requires file-ID proof before any page access or SQL. Catalog inode/ACL/append-only restart anchoring and critical DB/auxiliary/key file race protections are sufficient within the explicit trusted-account threat model. One lifecycle gap remains: a zero-byte cleanup_quarantined append failure leaves the old catalog valid, so a new supervisor has no durable record of the failed attempt despite the process-local fail-closed instruction.

round13_disposition.evidence: §3 requires direct verified-handle consumption by pilot VFS, pre-page/pre-SQL file-ID verification, prohibits PRAGMA/path reopen, and mandates fail-closed if unsupported. The negative matrix asserts zero page/SQL/receipt access on identity mismatch.

findings.title: Failed quarantine persistence has no restart anchor
findings.evidence: §3 requires global fail-closed if cleanup_quarantined append/Sync fails. A failure before bytes persist can leave a valid catalog with prior case state; the process-local latch is not described as surviving supervisor restart.
findings.risk: A restarted supervisor may not know that quarantine was attempted and may open the case according to stale prior state.
findings.required_revision: State whether fail-closed lasts only for the current process or must survive restart. For durable behavior, add a separate protected latch or equivalent recovery mechanism and define its own failure handling; otherwise prohibit supervisor restart pending operator verification and explicit clear. Add zero-byte append failure followed by restart acceptance case.

control_dispositions.sqlite_verified_handle_vfs: closed_in_design; file ID checked before any page access or SQL; no PRAGMA/path reopen
control_dispositions.catalog_stable_identity: sufficient under protected parent ACL and explicit trusted-account threat boundary
control_dispositions.catalog_append_only_restart_validation: strict schema/generation/frame validation; catalog HMAC mismatch remains closed and no MAC is required
control_dispositions.critical_db_wal_sidecar_key_races: specified with held handles, no-follow directory-relative operations, permissions, and identity checks
control_dispositions.cleanup_quarantine_restart_failure: underspecified after zero-byte append/Sync failure; open P2

remaining_conditions: Clarify persistence semantics for a failed cleanup quarantine append and its supervisor restart behavior.
limitations: No tests or runtime validation were run.
No SQLite VFS, filesystem race, ACL/catalog, key, database, or supervisor restart behavior was inspected at runtime.
This review does not approve implementation, production deployment, real student data, or classroom readiness.
